Wall Measurement Report Service

Wall Measurement Reports

Residential & commercial wall measurements for faster estimating.

Professional wall measurement reports for contractors, adjusters and restoration teams who need dependable exterior quantities for residential and commercial properties without the extra field work.

Every wall measurement report is prepared with clear elevation views, wall area totals, masonry and siding area breakdowns, windows and doors counts, and clean report pages that are easy to review during estimating or claim documentation.

Built for estimating

Built for siding, masonry and exterior takeoffs

Our wall measurement reports are designed to help you quantify exterior surfaces faster and more confidently. Whether you are estimating repairs, preparing a restoration scope, or documenting wall areas for a claim, the report stays clear, organized and practical.

✓Wall area details by each side elevation
✓Total wall area excluding windows and doors
✓Masonry area and siding area shown separately
✓Windows and doors report with per-elevation counts
✓Waste factor support and soffit details
✓Clean PDF layout that is easy to review and share
What's inside

What’s included in a wall measurement report

We organized the page to mirror the actual sample report structure, so visitors can immediately understand what they receive with each order.

01

Cover Page & Property Summary

A clean first page with aerial view, property reference, and a clear contents structure for the complete report.

02

Wall Measurements & Elevations

Wall views and elevation visuals help your team understand each side of the structure quickly and consistently.

03

Area by Elevation

Front, right, back and left elevation areas are organized side by side for quick review during estimating.

04

Masonry & Siding Breakdown

Exterior surface quantities are separated by material type wherever applicable for better scope planning.

05

Windows & Doors Report

Openings are counted and broken down by elevation to help support exterior calculations and validation.

06

Waste Factor & Soffit Details

Useful support pages add more clarity for material planning, especially for siding-related estimating work.
